explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem is about two functions the library defines itself: `delimit`, which doubles each bit and appends the separator `[false, true]`, and `takeFirstBlock`, which keeps the first framed block of a list. All of its content comes from these local definitions, so Mathlib cannot contain it. The proof is an induction that uses only the definitions' own equations and generic simp lemmas. I did not run any searches in the Mathlib sources: I read the library file and decided from the definitions alone.
